A '''grav motor''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Engine/Legends|engine]] component. The [[Curich-class shuttle|''Curich''-class shuttle]] [[Resurgence (Curich-class)|''Resurgence'']] suffered a grav motor malfunction after being attacked by [[The Irregulars|Irregular]] [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighters]] in the [[Fakir sector/Legends|Fakir sector]], causing the ship to list badly and crash on [[Abonshee]].<ref name="Godking" />
